en_US: Where are you off to with Pokémon?
The Pokémon League?
Are your Pokémon loyal enough for
you to win?
Let me see...
Ah! Your Pokémon trusts you
very much.
It’s nice to see a good Trainer.
Here. A gift for your journey.
TM37 happens to be Sandstorm.
It’s a move that inflicts damage on
both your and your foe’s Pokémon.
However, some Pokémon, such as Rock-
and Ground- and Steel-type
Pokémon, take no damage.
There are other ways to avoid taking
damage. I’ll let you figure it out.
If it doesn’t come to trust you some
more, it could be tough going.
Trust is the tie that binds Pokémon
and Trainers.
